defs.def: ot allowed by the law 不合法的；非法的；违法的adv.noun

ex.s: Writing fake reviews will be declared illegal.
ex.t: 撰写虚假评论将被宣布为非法。

ex.s: Private climate engineering is illegal in Canada.
ex.t: 我意识到我一直害怕有太多的渴望。

ex.s: By getting illegal practices under control．
ex.t: A．不受控的人类活动严重破坏生态系统。

ex.s: One thing I think we all agree on, though, is that saying “My AI did it” won’t be any excuse for illegal or immoral behaviour!
ex.t: 不过我想我们都同意一点：说“是我的人工智能干的”绝不能成为非法或不道德行为的借口！

ex.s: We could also say Whatever happens, I’m sure we can all agree that nobody will be able to blame their illegal or immoral behaviour on AI.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，无论发生什么，我相信大家都会同意：没有人能够把自己的非法或不道德行为归咎于人工智能。

ex.s: They were hunted, illegally, for their valuable fur.
ex.t: 它们因其珍贵的皮毛而被非法猎杀。

ex.s: Some graffiti murals and paintings were signs marking the territories of city gangs or illegal crime groups.
ex.t: 一些涂鸦壁画和画作是城市帮派或非法犯罪团伙领土的标志。

ex.s: It was illegal and punishable by fines.
ex.t: 那是非法的，可以被罚款。
